tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background, under the row lines. Every page sits on paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, terminal blocks, ghost buttons, tags: anything that lifts off the rows.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The horizontal row lines drawn every `row-pitch` across the page. Decorative only, never a divider that carries meaning.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of cards, post rows and the nav. Decorative: structure is also carried by `surface` vs `paper`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and ghost-button borders on `paper`, `surface` and `accent-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: lead paragraphs, excerpts, dates, nav links, labels. On `paper`, `surface` and `accent-tint`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: The quiet second half of a headline (24px+ only, 3:1 on `paper` and `surface`). Never body text, never on `accent-tint`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one colour: pixel icons, the active nav link, section numbers, primary buttons, the corner pin on cards, links. Text in `accent` reads on `paper`, `surface`, `accent-tint`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft blue glow at the top of a page, inline code, selected/hover fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (primary button, featured card).

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: The rotated stamp label only (one per page, at most). Not an error colour.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. 64px under 960px wide, 48px under 560px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles (whoami, portfolio, blog). 44px on phones.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Sections inside a post or the whoami page.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: First paragraph under a page title, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Excerpts, card bodies on phones, footer.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE section labels, kickers, stamps. Always uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminal blocks, code fences, inline code.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Phone gutter; gaps between tags and buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; one row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections (two rows).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero top padding, footer top margin (three rows).

tokens.name: row-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between background row lines. Vertical rhythm snaps to multiples of it where it can.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, tags, code blocks. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Inputs only, if a form ever appears.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The round monogram disc in the nav. Nothing else.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of `.wrap`.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Pixel icons inline with 13–16px text (2px per pixel).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Card arrows, nav toggle (3px per pixel).

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Decorative plus/arrow next to page titles (4px per pixel).

tokens.name: shadow-pixel
tokens.usage: Hard offset shadow on hover of primary buttons and cards. No blurred shadows anywhere.
